title: Lieutenant Governor Vacancies & Legislative Pay
officialSummary: Would require an election to fill a lieutenant governor vacancy occurring more than 60 days before the next general election and authorize the Legislature to set specified legislative and lieutenant governor salaries.
plainEnglish: Changes how an early vacancy in the lieutenant governor's office is filled, and how pay is established for the lieutenant governor and state legislators.
yesMeans: Adopts the proposed vacancy-election and salary-setting changes.
noMeans: Keeps existing constitutional rules for vacancies and salaries.
costTaxImpact: The financial effects are not quantified in this guide. Read the state's ballot statement for full context.

title: Consolidating County School Systems
officialSummary: Would establish a constitutional process for two or more county school boards to combine into a single multi-county board of education.
plainEnglish: Creates a path for multiple county school systems to consolidate under one school board.
yesMeans: Allows the proposed multi-county school board consolidation process.
noMeans: Does not add that consolidation process to the constitution.
costTaxImpact: The financial effects are not quantified in this guide. Read the state's ballot statement for full context.

title: Pledge of Allegiance & Student-Led Prayer
officialSummary: Would place requirements concerning the daily Pledge of Allegiance and allowance for student-initiated, student-led prayer in Alabama's constitution.
plainEnglish: Would require public schools to conduct the Pledge of Allegiance at the start of the school day and allow student-initiated, student-led prayer at that time.
yesMeans: Adds the proposed requirements to the state constitution.
noMeans: Does not constitutionalize these requirements; existing state law remains in place.
costTaxImpact: The financial effects are not quantified in this guide. Read the state's ballot statement for full context.

title: National Anthem in Public Schools
officialSummary: Would require public schools to broadcast or arrange a performance of the first stanza of The Star-Spangled Banner at least weekly.
plainEnglish: Would require public schools to play or arrange a performance of the first verse of the national anthem at least once per week.
yesMeans: Adds the weekly anthem requirement to the state constitution.
noMeans: Does not add the weekly anthem requirement to the constitution.
costTaxImpact: The financial effects are not quantified in this guide. Read the state's ballot statement for full context.
